title: Source code for the book การรับรู้เชิงบีบอัด (Compressive Sensing)
description: Python scripts, run logs and TikZ diagram sources that reproduce every figure and numerical result in the Thai-language monograph การรับรู้เชิงบีบอัด (Compressive Sensing). code/MANIFEST.md maps each figure and table to its script, section, random seed and log.
